title: Manifest sharedAssets and its check
goal: solution.json accepts sharedAssets and solution.mjs check validates them
acceptance: sharedAssets entries {id, component, kind: ui|logic|evaluation} accepted in the solution manifest
check fails on an unknown component, an unknown kind or a duplicate id
Fixture tests in tools/test-profiles.mjs, committed failing first
A solution without sharedAssets is unchanged
privacy: Fixtures are invented repositories and manifests; no personal data.
escalation: A change to how existing gap kinds behave goes back to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: a manifest field, its validation and fixtures. Not a measurement.
